action: Guan Yu grab-and-throw (new for Red Cliffs Ablaze, issue #3 M1 gate)

attempts.result: USED. Clear readable throw: frames 13-19 extended-arm hold at arm's length (grip), 21-25 haul-in, 29-31 heave/release, 33-35 recovery to ready stance. Identity/beard/costume stable, camera locked, feet grounded, full body always visible.
attempts.caveat: Per the prompt's 'plants his guandao butt-down' the model lay the guandao on the ground during the grapple; he re-grips it in recovery. Kept honestly (reads as setting the weapon down to seize the soldier) rather than painting it out.

attempts.result: REJECTED. Keeps the guandao in hand as asked, but the hold phase is just the ready stance (no readable grip) and the weapon vanishes during the heave (frames 27-31), so synchronization with a held victim would read worse.

processing.finalize: assets-source/guanyu/finalize-throw.py — reuses the shipped guanyu transform (SCALE 1.02, ground 472); dx recovered from shipped attack_0 vs the identical clip first frame (dx=-11.9, dy=-9.4). Same two-stage magenta despill as normalize.py.
processing.output: public/assets/frames/guanyu/throw_0..8.png; manifest actions.throw=9, strikeFrac.throw=0.625 (release tick = output index 5, source frame 29), grip={dx:160, dy:-247} canvas px from (originX, groundY) measured at the extended hand of the hold frame

gameSync: The victim is a separately placeable sprite: while grabbed it is pinned to the manifest grip point in front of Guan Yu; the throw animation is time-scaled to 560ms and the victim is released exactly at strikeFrac.throw with fixed velocity, then becomes a physics body that damages other enemies once each. Grab hold still uses throw_0 (the extended-arm pose).
qualityNotes: Beard, hands, grip, costume and foot contact read well at gameplay scale on the dark fleet decks. The ground-laid guandao is visible as a thin line at the feet during hold frames (see caveat). No magenta fringe visible after despill on dark backgrounds. Attempt count: 2 of max 3 used.
